$comment: Completion bar for #39: a chat reply that lands after the user switched sessions must not overwrite the thread they are now viewing, the user's message appears immediately (optimistically) instead of only once the reply arrives, and a chat send uses its own per-action busy flag so a concurrent Find search clearing the shared busy flag cannot re-enable Send and race a second send. useChat guards setMessages on the active session id, exposes a `sending` flag, and ChatView disables Send while `sending`.
